demos.title: Balanced
demos.prompt: a ceramic travel mug on a wooden desk in a bright studio, no readable text
demos.lesson: The all-rounder: subject, palette, and layout each arrive a little; the prompt still leads.

demos.title: Keep the same subject
demos.prompt: a product photo on a marble countertop in warm morning light, no readable text
demos.lesson: The reference's subject travels into the prompt's new scene. Strength-hungry by design: expect it to fire from ~0.9 up.

demos.title: Copy pose and layout
demos.prompt: ceramic bottles and bowls arranged on a studio table, soft daylight, no readable text
demos.lesson: Arrangement without appearance: the reference is studied as a grayscale blur, so placement arrives and color stays the prompt's.

demos.title: Copy lighting and mood
demos.prompt: a matte ceramic sphere on a small plinth, neutral gray studio backdrop, soft even light, clean unmarked design, no readable text
demos.lesson: Borrows the reference's light color and tonal mood as a scene-wide cast; the sphere and plinth stay the prompt's.

demos.title: Suggest the visual style
demos.prompt: a matte ceramic sphere on a small plinth, neutral gray studio backdrop, soft even light, clean unmarked design, no readable text
demos.lesson: The bolder sibling of the palette recipe (same inputs, same seed): the source's palette and energy arrive, the subject stays untouched.

demos.title: Suggest material or texture
demos.prompt: a matte ceramic sphere on a small plinth, neutral gray studio backdrop, soft even light, clean unmarked design, no readable text
demos.lesson: Borrows the material reference's surface palette and finish energy - the slate-and-sand weave arrives as a stony recolor. Runs the hottest shape of the appearance family because its gain table is the mildest.

demos.title: Copy big shapes only
demos.prompt: a minimalist ceramic sculpture on a white plinth, gallery lighting, no readable text
demos.lesson: Silhouette guidance: the reference is reduced to a shape wash, so only the big masses steer the composition.

demos.title: Avoid copying text/logos
demos.prompt: a plain cardboard shipping box on a white table, soft studio light, no readable text
demos.lesson: The guard recipe clamps itself to 0.03 no matter the slider and rewrites the prompt toward blank surfaces: the label-covered reference cannot deposit markings.

demos.title: Suggest the color palette
demos.prompt: a matte ceramic sphere on a small plinth, neutral gray studio backdrop, soft even light, clean unmarked design, no readable text
demos.lesson: Palette-only borrows color relationships and nothing else: the palette arrives, the abstract source shapes do not.

demos.title: Use the background/setting
demos.prompt: a sculptural table lamp on a small side table, editorial product photo, cohesive interior scene, no readable text
demos.lesson: Borrows the setting's palette and room mood while the prompt keeps the lamp. It suggests the atmosphere of the place, not a pasted backdrop.

demos.title: Copy the camera framing
demos.prompt: three ceramic vases in a row on a low wooden table, plain unmarked surfaces, soft daylight, refined product photography, no readable text
demos.lesson: Framing borrows camera distance, crop, and viewpoint only - grayscale study, structure-heavy early, quiet late.

demos.title: Mood board only
demos.prompt: a calm desk scene with a small ceramic lamp and a closed notebook, editorial photo, no readable text
demos.lesson: Loose inspiration under a hard 0.9 cap: a gentle borrowed palette and feeling, never a dictated composition.

demos.title: Palette journey: prompt only
demos.prompt: a matte ceramic sphere on a small plinth, neutral gray studio backdrop, soft even light, clean unmarked design, no readable text
demos.lesson: Baseline for the palette pair: the prompt alone asks for a neutral gray scene.

demos.title: Timing: style, early layout only
demos.prompt: a modern table lamp in a clean studio product photo, no readable text
demos.lesson: The style card guides only the first 40% of steps: broad color fields and composition arrive early, then the prompt's own finish passes smooth the surfaces.

demos.title: Timing: style, final details only
demos.prompt: a modern table lamp in a clean studio product photo, no readable text
demos.lesson: Same seed, same card, opposite timing: the prompt owns the early composition and the source arrives in the detail passes - its rose-and-sage palette lands as a crisp two-tone finish on the prompt's lamp.

demos.title: Counter-example journey: prompt only
demos.prompt: a sculptural table lamp in a clean studio product photo, no readable text
demos.lesson: Step one of the direction journey: the prompt alone, no reference cards.

demos.title: Counter-example journey: style pulled toward
demos.prompt: a sculptural table lamp in a clean studio product photo, no readable text
demos.lesson: Step two: the style source pulled toward at 0.65 - palette, finish, art direction arrive.

demos.title: Counter-example journey: style pushed away
demos.prompt: a sculptural table lamp in a clean studio product photo, no readable text
demos.lesson: Step three: the same card set to away steers the result out of the source's palette and manner. Away pushes harder per slider unit, so start lower.

demos.title: Full showcase - six jobs
demos.prompt: a ceramic travel mug on a wooden desk in a bright studio, no readable text
demos.lesson: Six cards, one job each, balance off.

demos.title: Full showcase - gentle balance
demos.prompt: a ceramic travel mug on a wooden desk in a bright studio, no readable text
demos.lesson: The same six cards under gentle balance: the stack budgets the total pull so strong cards degrade gracefully instead of fighting.
